notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers authenticating to and pushing/pulling images from Docker Hub, Amazon ECR, Azure ACR, Google Artifact Registry and GHCR, ECR lifecycle and cross-account repository policies, ACR retention and geo-replication, Artifact Registry cleanup policies, running a self-hosted registry or Harbor, scan-on-push and Docker Content Trust.

Medium: following it has the agent log in to registries with the user's tokens ($DOCKER_TOKEN, $GITHUB_TOKEN, service-principal secrets, cloud CLI tokens), create registries/repositories, set lifecycle, cleanup and cross-account access policies, push images, and download and run the Harbor online installer. Acceptable because these are standard registry operations on the user's own cloud accounts; tokens are piped via --password-stdin in most examples, and the Harbor installer is pinned to release v2.9.0 and extracted before running (not piped to a shell).

Users should know: lifecycle/cleanup policies (SKILL.md:110-127, 264-276) expire images automatically and the cross-account policy (SKILL.md:134-151) grants pull access to another AWS account, so confirm values first; `az acr login --expose-token` (SKILL.md:182) prints a token to the terminal and `docker login -p $SP_PASSWORD` (SKILL.md:177-179) puts a secret on the command line; the Harbor download has no checksum check. Related Skills (SKILL.md:409-411) link to sibling skills ../docker-management/, ../../../security/scanning/container-scanning/, ../../../infrastructure/cloud-aws/aws-iam/ as optional reading only.
